items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: I heard James Brown and Little Stevie Wonder and all that stuff for the first time and that had a — you know I probably sat up straight in bed. That just hit a nerve.

ctx.x: Oh sure, sure. I had listened to him as a kid you know, going back to when I was still home in Philly the R&B station — it’s unusual — most guys will say that they listened to rock & roll or R&B first and then they caught on to jazz. I did the opposite. I hadn’t heard all this other stuff, I was just hearing bebop at home. And one day, and I’d always listened to the radio, the jazz station, WHAT, before I went to sleep but there was another station on the AM dial that was right past the jazz station. I think the…
So you’re probably familiar with the DownBeat blindfold tests.
